name: erp
description: ERP backend foundation for construction domain

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.verify:ci: npm run audit:prod && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run check:prisma-stack && npm run prisma:validate && npm run validate:api-contract-yaml && npm run check:dunning-inventory && npm run validate:compliance-artifacts && npm run validate:compliance-signoffs && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run test -w apps/web && npm test
scripts.verify:ci:with-migrate: npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run verify:ci
scripts.verify:ci:local-db: npm run ensure:local-test-db && sh -c 'export DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://erp:erp@127.0.0.1:15432/erp_test} PERSISTENCE_DB_TEST_URL=${PERSISTENCE_DB_TEST_URL:-postgresql://erp:erp@127.0.0.1:15432/erp_test} && npm run verify:ci:with-migrate'
scripts.e2e:kill-dev-ports: sh -c 'for p in 13000 15173; do lsof -ti TCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; true; done'
scripts.verify:pre-merge: npm run verify:ci && npm run e2e:kill-dev-ports && sleep 1 && npx playwright test e2e/app-shell-smoke.spec.ts e2e/login-finance-smoke.spec.ts && npm run e2e:kill-dev-ports && sleep 1 && npx playwright test e2e/login-finance-smoke-fin5-tail.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:postgres: sh -c 'if [ -z "${DATABASE_URL:-}" ]; then echo "test:e2e:postgres: DATABASE_URL erforderlich (z. B. nach npm run ensure:local-test-db)" >&2; exit 1; fi; npx prisma migrate deploy && E2E_USE_POSTGRES=1 npx playwright test e2e/app-shell-smoke.spec.ts e2e/login-finance-smoke.spec.ts'
